summary: CucinaSmart AI backend fully tested via pytest against public preview URL. 32/32 tests passed (100%) covering Auth (signup/signin/me/logout, duplicates, invalid creds), Recipes CRUD, Pantry CRUD with location filter, Shopping CRUD + clear-checked, Meals CRUD with date-range filter, AI chat + history, what-can-i-cook (empty pantry + with ingredients, Gemini 3 Flash), import-photo (base64 JPEG with real visual features via Gemini vision), and Upload + Files (multipart JPEG upload to Emergent Object Storage, retrieval via short-lived token query and via Bearer, 401 without auth). All endpoints authenticated via Bearer session_token as expected.
action_items: Backend is production-ready for the listed endpoints; proceed with frontend UI implementation/testing.
Optional: add rate limiting on AI endpoints and validation limits on image_base64 size to protect from abuse.
Optional: add pagination to list endpoints (currently capped at 500-1000 items).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 547 lines; consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, recipes, pantry, shopping, meals, ai, storage) as it grows.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in favor of FastAPI lifespan handlers.
PATCH endpoints accept raw Dict[str, Any] without a Pydantic model — partial validation only; consider dedicated Update models.
/api/upload response builds URL manually; safer to return absolute URL using EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for client convenience.
Chat history is stored but not sent as context to LlmChat (relies on library session_id) — fine, but the loaded `prev` variable is unused (dead code).
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Fixtures create ephemeral test users (email prefix `test_` / `TEST_`) and clean up their own recipes/pantry/shopping/meals within tests. Uploaded test images remain in Object Storage under `cucinasmart-ai/uploads/<user_id>/` (small JPEGs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_cucinasmart_api.py as regression suite. Env var: EXPO_BACKEND_URL (falls back to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). AI endpoints call Gemini 3 Flash via emergentintegrations and take 3-15s each; timeouts already generous. Image test uses PIL to generate a realistic (non-blank, gradient + shapes + lines) 256x256 JPEG per the /app/image_testing.md rules.
